
```jsx
import { CxForm } from '@chassis-ui/react'
// or
import CxForm from '@chassis-ui/react/src/react/src/components/form/CxForm'
```

| Property | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **className** | A string of all className you want applied to the component. | `string` \| `undefined` | - |
| **validated** | Mark a form as validated. If you set it `true`, all validation styles will be applied to the forms component. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
